description: Research r18 (dev only, H200): D 003's RL (D 002's config, fp32 master weights, lr 3e-6 constant, zero-advantage rows skipped, 14,040 s) from D 003's own pretrained models (screen_pretrained), with prompts_per_step 256 instead of 64 and lr 6e-06. In D 003's RL, sampling takes ~0.9 of ~1.05 s per step (vLLM scheduling of a 110M model, CPU-bound), only ~5 of 64 groups are informative (entropy ~0.055), and dev was still rising at 234 min on seeds 2-4. Four times the prompts per step should cost well under four times the step time and give ~20 informative groups per update. Seeds pair with D 003's seeds on the same pretrained models and GPU type (seed 0's RL ran at half speed on node4900, so seeds 1-3 come first).
